verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents an embedding API with a registry of embedding functions and schemas. OpenAI is registered in that registry by default, and OpenCLIP and VoyageAI integrations are also documented. Custom embedding functions are supported, and a raw query image can be passed straight to search, which shows query-time embedding is handled by the database rather than a separate pipeline. Missing for 10: an explicit verbatim statement that embeddings are computed automatically on insert/ingest, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: Use the embedding API in LanceDB -- registry, functions, schemas, and multi-language SDK support.
LanceDB registers the OpenAI embeddings function in the registry by default, as `openai`.
